name: Asgaldh ~Waikyoku no Testament~
original_name: アスガルド ～歪曲のテスタメント～
source:
You play the role of young warrior named Ashu. One day you meet a girl who is attacked by a monster. Saving the girl, you find out she is the daughter of a village elder. The girl's father is impressed by your skills and tells you you must venture into the monsters' lair. But as you come back, you discover the monsters have kidnapped the elder's daughter! Now you must find companions for your quest (all female) to rescue the girl and to find out what causes monster attacks.

This is a traditional Japanese RPG with the addition of erotic elements. You wander around the top-down world, fighting randomly appearing monsters in turn-based combat viewed from first-person perspective. Character and battle graphics have a distinct animé style. You can also impress your female companions, giving them treasures, talking to them, etc. This will influence the girls' efficiency in battles and also your relationship with them.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/asgaldh-the-distortion-testament]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演名叫阿修的年轻战士。一天，你遇见一名遭怪物袭击的女孩。救下她后，你得知她是村中长老的女儿。女孩的父亲对你的身手十分赞赏，告诉你必须深入怪物巢穴。然而，当你返回村庄时，却发现怪物绑架了长老的女儿！如今，你必须寻找同伴——她们全是女性——一同踏上旅程，营救女孩并查明怪物发动袭击的原因。

本作是一款加入色情元素的传统日式角色扮演游戏。你会在俯视视角的世界中四处探索，并以第一人称视角进行随机遇敌的回合制战斗。角色与战斗画面具有鲜明的动画风格。玩家还可以通过赠送宝物、交谈等方式赢得女性同伴的好感。这会影响女孩们的战斗效率，以及她们与你的关系。

[摘自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/asgaldh-the-distortion-testament]Moby Games[/url]]
